Hi Julia — thanks for the questionnaire. I reviewed BrightHealth_Vendor_Sec_Q_20260620.xlsx and here are the concise answers and options so procurement can slot them into the form: 

1) Primary deletion: when a customer issues an account- or dataset-level deletion request, we remove active records and associated indices within 30 days (standard). We provide a signed deletion certificate on request.

2) Backups: backups are retained for the configured window (default 180 days). Backups are written as snapshots and are immutable for integrity; we do not perform ad-hoc in-place deletes of snapshots. For customers requiring shorter retention we offer two options:
   - Contracted reduced retention: reduce backup retention to 90 days (available as a standard option; sometimes requires a short notice for operational changes).
   - Backup rotation & targeted scrubbing: for extreme compliance requests, we can perform an explicit scrub/overwrite of affected data in the next backup cycle and provide attestations — this is treated as an escalated operational flow and has a lead time (~2-4 weeks) and project-level cost depending on data volume.

3) Deleting from backups: because of snapshot immutability, we cannot guarantee that a specific object will be zeroed retroactively in an existing immutable snapshot without performing a rotation/scrub operation described above. We will document the process and provide evidence (operation logs and attestation).

4) Logs: audit/log retention is configurable per tenancy. Default: 365 days. We can set prod to 365 and lower environments to 90 on request.

5) SOC 2 / BAA: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report via the secure portal once we have an NDA; BAA is available — legal has an editable draft we can share this week.
